A CLOSER LOOK

YOUR DETAILS
A little privacy.
Your enquiry is prepared in your browser. This website does not store booking information in a database or take payments. Your details are passed to WhatsApp when you choose to continue and are sent to the host only when you send the message there.
WhatsApp and linked social services have their own privacy policies. The host uses the information you share to discuss your stay. For questions about your information, email shelohhomes@gmail.com.
